purpose: Retain the source code identifier errno in speech instead of relying on a generic error-code gloss. Preserve the approximate-count alternative, historical talk and book, contrast with no return value, two outcomes and each-operation failure qualification.
source: So I don't totally agree with void but one approach is to give an approximate number and the talk last year talked about that and this book has more. But I'll come close to void instead of no value I'll return one of two and that would be zero for success and errno for failure. And as far as I know you only have one type of failure for each of these. So Boolean which is pretty close.
before_display: 所以，我不完全赞成返回 void。一种办法是返回近似数量；去年的报告讲过，书里也有更多介绍。不过，我也会选一个接近 void 的办法：不是完全不返回值，而是返回两类结果，成功为零，失败返回 errno 错误码。据我所知，这两个操作，各自都只有一种失败情况，那用一个布尔结果也差不多。
